items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All five requested deliverables are present; the forbidden delivery, hook, SKILL, and phase-list surfaces are unchanged.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Malformed events, timestamps, run IDs, watcher output, timeouts, and unsupported phases resolve to explicit non-success verdicts without exceptions.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: The oracle is read-only, validates iterate run IDs before path use, rejects option-like branch names, and does not read or emit credentials.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Regression tests exercise session isolation, legacy C1 compatibility, strict since boundaries, delivery outcomes, CLI exits, and invalid-input paths.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: The oracle performs bounded local event reads and one 70-second-capped watcher subprocess only for iterate delivery checks.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New helpers and CLI follow existing shared tools/verifiers layout and retain existing public function behavior by adding siblings and keyword-only options.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Changed JSONL boundary: record_event-produced phase_completed/work_completed records are written to disk in tests, then consumed by read_run_events and oracle verdict checks; exact-session and since-fallback paths passed.
